title: Software Art Thou: Glenn Vanderburg - Real Software Engineering
summary: Glenn Vanderburg asks whether software development can be real engineering, surveying other engineering disciplines and decades of programming experience. He envisions what a software engineering worthy of the name might look like.
why: HN recommends it in debates about software engineering rigor, agile, and formal methods.

quote.text: he explores the question of whether "software engineering" is or can really be engineering.
